title: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "This is Tukang Copilot. Fix it yourself, safely, even in Javanese."]
hook: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["id-ID-ArdiNeural", "Aduh motorku mogok, bengkelnya tutup lagi."], "In Indonesia, a small fault on a motorbike or a water pump can cost a day's wage. Repair videos can't see your problem, and most aren't in your language."]
intro: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Take a photo and say what's wrong. These are real answers from Meta's models, recorded on a live run. The photos are AI-generated samples."]
progress: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Each result shows up as soon as it's ready: what Muse Spark saw, the parts SAM outlined, then the likely cause."]
question: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "If it isn't sure, it asks one short question instead of guessing."]
diagnosis: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Then the diagnosis. Likely causes with confidence, a safety level, tools and time, and the parts cost next to the bengkel price."]
parts: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "SAM 3.1 marks the parts on your own photo, not on some generic diagram."]
preflight: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Before step one, there's a short safety checklist. The steps stay locked until it's done."]
live: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Point the camera, and SAM 3.1 outlines the part to touch, about once a second. Here it's Chromium's test camera playing a sample photo."]
check_fail: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "After each step, you send a photo, and Muse Spark compares it with what it should look like. This one's too dark, so it asks for a retake."]
check_pass: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "A clear photo of the plug cap back on passes, and it moves on."]
handsfree: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Hands dirty? Turn on hands-free. It reads each step out loud and listens for simple voice commands."]
replan: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Still broken? Tell it what happened, and it moves on to the next likely cause. Plan, act, check, re-plan."]
diagram: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "When a photo can't show a step, like the washer inside a tap, Muse Image draws a diagram, and Muse Spark checks it."]
agent: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Every decision stays on screen: what it saw, why it asked, each photo check, and which model did it."]
handoff: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "When it's a job for a pro, one tap hands it over: a WhatsApp summary, the nearest bengkel, and a PDF brief for the mechanic."]
rice: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "And it knows when to say no. A rice cooker that won't heat means opening 220 volt parts, so it stops and sends you to a service centre."]
wa: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["jv-ID-SitiNeural", "Kran pawonku netes terus, piye iki?"], "It works in WhatsApp too, in Javanese. Send a photo, and the same agent replies with the marked photo, the diagnosis, and a button for each step. A gas leak still gets a red stop."]
arch: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Under the hood: Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark to see, reason and check, SAM 3.1 for masks and live tracking, and Muse Image for diagrams. The safety rules live in code."]
close: ["en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural", "-4%", "trimmed", -16.0, ["", ""], "Tukang Copilot. Every phone becomes a mechanic's apprentice."]
